items.html: But the Ruach is revealed in the heart, which stands in the ChGT of ZA, for there are the ChGT of the NHY, and the ChGT of the ChGT, and the ChGT of the KHB. And the Neshama is revealed in the brain, which stands in the KHB of ZA, for there are the KHB of the NHY, and the KHB of the ChGT, and the KHB of the KHB.
